name: enclosure_chat_noir
description: Block one hex cell per turn to surround the cat before it reaches the boundary.

difficulty_params.difficulty: Official generation and benchmark difficulty is the cat policy: easy policy = easy, medium policy = medium, hard policy = hard.

board_radius.role: Setup parameter; default generation samples 3 or 4 from the seed; does not define difficulty.

difficulty_params.initial_block_count: Setup parameter for the number of cells blocked before the first player action; default generation samples a policy- and radius-dependent count from the seed: radius 3 uses easy=8-10, medium=10-12, hard=12-14; radius 4 uses easy=10-13, medium=13-16, hard=16-19. Blocker positions are sampled uniformly at random from non-cat cells; initial_block_count does not define difficulty.
difficulty_params.min_winning_first_actions: Default generation keeps only setups where the bounded solver finds at least 5 distinct first block moves that can still lead to trapping the cat for easy, medium, and hard. By default at least 3 of those winning first block moves must be adjacent to the cat's starting cell. Passing concrete --min-winning-first-actions or --min-adjacent-winning-first-actions values overrides these defaults.

cat_intelligence.easy: Cat that uses shortest-path greedy movement with 50% probability and otherwise chooses a legal adjacent move uniformly at random.
cat_intelligence.medium: Greedy shortest-path cat with simple tie-breaks.
cat_intelligence.hard: Connectivity-aware greedy cat that avoids immediate one-move traps when possible and preserves more escape connectivity.

difficulty_params.seed: Generation starts at seed_start and consumes one integer seed per generated setup.
difficulty_params.difficulty_score: The benchmark records cat_policy_level directly: easy=1, medium=2, hard=3.

success_condition: The cat no longer has any path from its current cell to the board boundary before it reaches a boundary cell.
